$comment: Feature 11 — deterministic pairwise compatibility rules. Same corridor NEVER implies compatibility; every verdict must trace to one of these rules. CP-SAT will consume these services later, so rules stay declarative and serialisable.

isolation_conflicts.$comment: Pairs of isolation demands that cannot coexist in one possession without a certification step.

incompatibility_rules.description: A machine-heavy method occupies the full track; no second party may work the same stretch.
Excavation over cable ducts forbids any S&T access to the same stretch.
One job de-energises the OHE while the other needs it energised for testing.

conditional_rules.description: Jobs sharing a machine must run strictly one after the other with a handover.
After power is restored the dispatcher must certify the feed before energised testing.

parallel_rules.description: Line-side / non-exclusive methods may work the same protection in parallel.

method_classification.$comment: Coarse work-method classification used by the rules above.

isolation_demand.$comment: How each job attribute translates into an isolation demand tag.
